reviews.comment: Very cool guy, can seem weird but he just wants the students to learn. A lot of examples, and talks about a wide variety of math. Will say a lot of content in his lectures won't be on the exam, but he does provide reviews so you know what to expect. Doesn't post notes or lecture recordings. Would recommend.

Prof is eccentric, but after a few weeks, it's easy to see he's not weird. I liked the in-class examples intended for math appreciation. Homework is mostly easy, and feel free to get creative on the exploration problems. Test questions are basic (the true/false are the hardest), and a paper following only the syllabus rubric will earn a 100.

While the class is not a free class, it is reasonably doable and fairly graded. I'd recommending actually trying on the weekly HWs not only for the HW grade but also because it shows up on the test. Lectures get boring occasionally, but not bad overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof. Clearly explains everything and works up from definitions to applications. Lots of examples of proofs during lecture. Clear grading criteria, and not a tough grader. Not the easiest class because of the course material, but Rowell is worth taking MATH300 with.

I felt like he went on tangents during lecture and made us do some activities that were completely unrelated to what we were learning. He was hard to follow sometimes but was a pretty good lecturer and showed great interest in pure math. He was extremely accessible outside class and even sent me lecture notes from previous years when I was sick.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, doesn't copy on the blackboard from pre-prepared notes, very natural flow, gives motivation for whatever he is going to be talking about, proofs are done methodically and clearly, shows ways in which said things can be used. Exercise load is on the heavier side (but reasonable), & most have something useful to teach you. TAKE HIM!

I took Rowell because of his current rating, but I'm going to stop others from making the same mistake. Math 300 is one of the hardest classes I've taken, and most of Rowell's lectures involved us trying to read his handwriting while he moved fast. Rowell is extremely knowledgeable about math but he assumes that his students are on the same level.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Brilliant professor who knows his stuff. What he expects over the course of the semester is very clear. A couple of pop quizzes early on but nothing too difficult. His lectures can often be interactive. Strongly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is nerdy and knows what he is talking about. Grade is based off of 2 tests, homework, writing assignment, journal (he gives topics to write on), and a final. I think he is a good prof and would recommend him.
